shots.name: mobile-cartao
steps: const t = document.querySelector('textarea'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(t, ['Feliz aniversário, meu amor!', 'Que o seu dia seja tão lindo quanto você.'].join(String.fromCharCode(10))); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); document.activeElement.blur();
const h = document.querySelector('main form').closest('div'); window.scrollTo(0, h.getBoundingClientRect().top + scrollY - 76);

shots.name: desktop-resumo
steps: const t = document.querySelector('textarea'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(t, ['Obrigada por tudo!', 'Com carinho.'].join(String.fromCharCode(10))); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));

const s = document.querySelector('main form select'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(s, 'jardim-primavera'); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));

const i = document.querySelector('main form input:not([type])'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(i, 'Ana (exemplo)'); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
